SELECT event_content_id AS event_id, event_name AS title, event_type, district_name AS district, event_start_date AS start_date, event_end_date AS end_date, free_yn, use_fee AS fee, image_url FROM event WHERE
ORDER BY LEAST(2147483647,
CASE WHEN event_start_date <= #{date} AND event_end_date >= #{date} THEN DATEDIFF(#{date}, event_start_date) ELSE 2147483647 END
) ASC, event_end_date ASC, event_content_id ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN event_start_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 WHEN event_end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 2 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN event_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND event_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN event_start_date END DESC, CASE WHEN event_start_date > CURRENT_DATE THEN event_start_date END ASC, CASE WHEN event_end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN event_end_date END DESC, event_end_date ASC, event_content_id ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN event_end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN event_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE THEN event_end_date END ASC, CASE WHEN event_end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN event_end_date END DESC, event_content_id ASC
ORDER BY event_name ASC, event_content_id ASC
ORDER BY event_start_date ASC, event_content_id ASC
LIMIT #{criteria.size} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
